title: Keeping a paper journal changed my mornings
main: Reading one book a week reminded me that progress is rarely a straight line and the numbers backed it up. Keeping a paper journal reminded me that the hardest part is starting which surprised me more than anything.

Growing tomatoes on a balcony showed me quickly that cheap tools are often good enough although my neighbors still think I am strange. Growing tomatoes on a balcony slowly proved that most advice online is too complicated which surprised me more than anything.

Training for a half marathon taught me that small habits matter more than big plans which surprised me more than anything. Keeping a paper journal made it obvious that progress is rarely a straight line so I kept a simple log for thirty days. My first week of cycling to work taught me that the hardest part is starting so I kept a simple log for thirty days.

Moving to a smaller apartment convinced me that most advice online is too complicated and I wish I had started sooner. Growing tomatoes on a balcony convinced me that small habits matter more than big plans which surprised me more than anything. Keeping a paper journal reminded me that boredom is usually a sign to change routine which surprised me more than anything.
